crossRefs.note: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for…
the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and…
“This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:

people.name: Gershon
people.line: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.

translations.web: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service.
translations.bsb: He gave the Gershonites two carts and four oxen, as their service required,
translations.kjv: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
translations.asv: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
